description: Search Storied Collection's historic exclusive-use venues (castles, estates, châteaux in Scotland, England, Wales, Ireland, France). All filters are optional and combined with AND. Prices are 'pricing from' per night in the venue's native currency (GBP or EUR) and are NEVER converted — max_price only matches venues priced in the given currency (default: any currency, compared numerically within each venue's own currency; pass max_price_currency to be precise). Venues with price 'On request' are excluded when max_price is set. Boolean filters exclude venues where the value is unknown. Returns a summary list; use get_venue for full details.

country.description: Country name, e.g. Scotland, England, Wales, Ireland, France (case-insensitive)

ev_charging.description: true = must have electric car charging; false = must not

guest_house.description: true = must have a guest house; false = no guest house

helipad.description: true = must have a helipad; false = must not

max_minimum_nights.description: Only venues whose minimum stay is at most this many nights

max_price_currency.description: Currency of max_price. Only venues priced in this currency are returned. No conversion is performed.

min_sleeps.description: Minimum number of guests the venue sleeps

query.description: Free-text match on venue name or country, e.g. 'castle', 'chateau', 'Gordon'

sort_by.description: Sort order (price ascending, sleeps descending, name A–Z). Default name.

name: search_venues
title: Search Storied Collection venues
